prompt: curl upload-file stdin non-blocking mode filename
answer:
Use a single period (`.`) as the `--upload-file` filename:

```bash
curl --upload-file . https://example.com/
```

A single dash (`-`) also reads from stdin, but `.` uses stdin in non-blocking mode, allowing curl to read server output while stdin is being uploaded.
